# esp-wifi-config-react-native

> React Native library for ESP-IDF Network Provisioning over BLE on devices running esp_wifi_config 0.2.0+ firmware (0.2.3 recommended). Three integration paths: pre-built navigator, hooks-only custom UI, or headless service classes. Step-machine driven; one error envelope; per-instance hook loading. Wraps Espressif's native iOS/Android SDK via @orbital-systems/react-native-esp-idf-provisioning.

If you are an AI agent helping integrate or modify this library, read CLAUDE.md first.

## Documentation

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Primary agent integration guide. Mental model, step machine table, action verbs, common pitfalls, file map. Read this first.
- [README.md](README.md): Human-and-agent quick start. Decision tree, install steps, security-version handling, code examples for all three integration paths.
- [API.md](API.md): Exhaustive symbol reference. When there's any conflict, prefer CLAUDE.md and the source.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): Internal layering and event flow for contributors. The integration-level model lives in CLAUDE.md.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release notes.
- [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md): Firmware-version alignment (what changed in esp_wifi_config 0.1.0 → 0.2.3 and how the library tracks it) plus the checklist for migrating an app from an earlier draft of this library.

## Guides

(SDK-backed transport, atomic provision(), conditional enterDeviceAuth step, ProvisioningError sources are 'ble' | 'protocol' | 'provision' | 'flow'.)

- [GUIDES/01-quick-start.md](GUIDES/01-quick-start.md): Minimal Expo app from zero to provisioned device.
- [GUIDES/02-custom-ui-with-hooks.md](GUIDES/02-custom-ui-with-hooks.md): Building a wizard from useProvisioning only, including the enterDeviceAuth screen.
- [GUIDES/03-headless-usage.md](GUIDES/03-headless-usage.md): BleTransport + DeviceProtocol in non-React code.
- [GUIDES/04-pre-wifi-customization.md](GUIDES/04-pre-wifi-customization.md): Using onConnected to set hostname or app variables before WiFi.
- [GUIDES/05-error-handling.md](GUIDES/05-error-handling.md): The unified ProvisioningError model in depth, including the unauthorized-bounce path.
- [GUIDES/06-managing-saved-networks.md](GUIDES/06-managing-saved-networks.md): Why post-provisioning management is over HTTP/REST, not BLE; the network-info endpoint; chunked responses and SoftAP-less builds.
- [GUIDES/07-testing-your-integration.md](GUIDES/07-testing-your-integration.md): Mocking the native SDK for unit tests.

## Examples

- [example_app/](example_app/): Full runnable Expo app — `ProvisioningNavigator` flow (app/provision.tsx) plus a Diagnostics tab exercising BleTransport/DeviceProtocol/custom endpoints. Links the library via `file:..`.
- [examples/minimal-app.tsx](examples/minimal-app.tsx): Bare ProvisioningNavigator inside Expo Router.
- [examples/custom-wizard.tsx](examples/custom-wizard.tsx): Hooks-driven wizard, ~200 lines.
- [examples/with-onconnected.tsx](examples/with-onconnected.tsx): Pre-WiFi mDNS hostname setup via custom protocomm endpoint.
- [examples/headless-script.ts](examples/headless-script.ts): Non-React provisioning script.

## Source map

- src/types/provisioning.ts: ProvisioningStep enum, error model, config shape, manager events.
- src/types/protocol.ts: Custom protocomm endpoint payload types.
- src/types/ble.ts: SecurityVersion, BleTransport events / config.
- src/types/wifi.ts: ScannedNetwork, ProvisionResult.
- src/services/BleTransport.ts: Layer 1, native SDK wrapper (scan, connect, disconnect, ESPDevice reference).
- src/services/DeviceProtocol.ts: Layer 2, SDK provision()/scanWifiList() + JSON-over-base64 custom protocomm endpoints.
- src/services/ProvisioningManager.ts: Layer 3, wizard step machine and verb-based actions.
- src/store/provisioningStore.ts: Zustand store wiring service events to React state.
- src/hooks/useProvisioning.ts: Primary wizard hook.
- src/hooks/: Other hooks (useDeviceScanner, useBleConnection, useDeviceProtocol, useDeviceVariables).
- src/screens/: Pre-built screens.
- src/navigation/ProvisioningNavigator.tsx: Drop-in wizard navigator.
- src/utils/permissions.ts: requestBluetoothPermissions helper.
